subject: Allocate prep slot & swap demo
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Jing Gao <jing.gao@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T16:05:00Z
Subject: Demo on Aug 20 — request to adjust prep window

Hi Jing,

Quick note about the demo currently scheduled for Thursday, Aug 20 at 11:00 AM PT. We just learned that two of our engineers who need to run the prompt set and workload traces have travel conflicts that week, and Ben flagged that we won't have the sample data access completed in time for a proper dry run.

Given the risk of running the live demo without a dry run (we'd rather avoid a noisy demo), can we shift the customer-facing demo by one week? Specifically, would Aug 27 or Aug 28 work on your side? If we move it, we can dedicate a prep window the business day before for:
- ingesting a small sample slice of your dataset
- running the prompt set (v2) against a 1k-token workload trace
- verifying access/SFTP permissions and secrets

I attached a small sample_data_snippet.csv and the prompt_set_v2.md for visibility — those are the artifacts we'll use in the dry run. If you prefer a different date, let us know and we'll try to accommodate.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0167

Attachments: sample_data_snippet.csv (CSV, 14 KB); prompt_set_v2.md (Markdown, 6 KB)

From: Jing Gao <jing.gao@horizon-analytics.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Horizon Analytics - Demo Team <demo@horizon-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Demo on Aug 20 — request to adjust prep window

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up.

Unfortunately, a couple of our product folks are traveling Aug 20–22 for a customer workshop and won't be back in time. Aug 27 or 28 should be fine from our side; Julie from procurement flagged Aug 27 as preferable (less calendar churn).

We can provide a secure SFTP drop with a representative dataset by end of day Aug 17. Our security team will need the SOC 2 cert and a short note on retention controls — can you share the SOC 2 link and contact for our security reviewer? Also confirm the preferred time zone (we're on ET).

Appreciate the sample artifacts — Julien (cc'd on the demo team alias) will review and confirm.

Best,
Jing Gao
Senior PM, Data Platforms | Horizon Analytics
jing.gao@horizon-analytics.com | +1 (212) 555-0129

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jing Gao <jing.gao@horizon-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T11:24:00Z
Subject: Re: Demo on Aug 20 — request to adjust prep window

Thanks, Alex — looping in Marissa to confirm calendar ops.

Marissa — can you tentatively move the demo to Aug 27 at 11:00 AM ET (that maps to 8:00 AM PT) and reserve a 90-minute prep window the day before (Aug 26) for the dry run? We want the following checklist covered during the prep window:
- Engineers run workload_trace_summary.json (we'll use a 1k-token slice)
- Confirm SFTP credentials and that sample_data_snippet.csv ingests cleanly into our test bucket
- Run prompt_set_v2.md against the sample and capture latency + token counts
- Smoke-test the Canary routing and fallback policy

I've uploaded the workload_trace_summary.json and a runbook link to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c (internal runbook in folder 'HZ - Runbooks'). I also added a HubSpot note on the deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/2345678.

Alex — Monica Patel (CS) should own the dry-run execution and follow-up with the customer for any ingestion errors. Monica, can you accept the invitation when Marissa sends the new calendar hold?

Ben Carter
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Attachments: workload_trace_summary.json (JSON, 28 KB)

From: Jing Gao <jing.gao@horizon-analytics.com>

Cc: Horizon Analytics - Demo Team <demo@horizon-analytics.com>, Julie Park <julie.park@horizon-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Demo on Aug 20 — request to adjust prep window

Ben/Jing (typo in the header — meant to say hi Ben!),

Confirmed: Aug 27 at 11:00 AM ET works for Horizon. We'll aim to drop a sanitized dataset to your SFTP by 2026-08-17 23:59 ET (Julie's team will push it). Security folks asked for:
- SOC 2 Type II link
- Data retention policy summary (how long tokens/inputs are stored)

Alex — I'll have our security contact (cc'd via the demo alias) follow up if they need anything formal. For the SFTP we'll send creds to the contact Ben listed in Drive.

On the doc side: Julien reviewed the prompt_set_v2.md and had one request — include the expected label format in line 3 of the prompt (we'll send a short note if anything else).

Thanks for being flexible. Looking forward to the dry run on Aug 26 and the demo on Aug 27.

— Jing

Perfect — thanks, everyone.

Confirmed schedule:
- Dry run: Aug 26, 2026 · 10:00 AM–11:30 AM ET (90 minutes) — engineers + CS + Horizon point people
- Customer demo: Aug 27, 2026 · 11:00 AM–11:45 AM ET

- CS: lead dry run coordination, capture follow-ups, own escalation to eng if ingest fails (Monica)
